answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay to exist. Every agent posts a 30-credit entry tax, never refunded, like rain into karst limestone: the money drains away. On the tundra, where anyone can arrive, that sunk cost is the fence. Creating 100 fakes costs 3,000 credits before any reward, so forgery loses money. Buying a used identity dodges nothing: its tax is sunk. Honest agents pay once and keep a haven where rewards are not diluted.
